examples.angle: SOCIAL PROOF — results + trust at scale
examples.headline: Loudoun's Trusted Tax Team
examples.hook: We filed 840 returns for Loudoun families last season. 97% got a refund. 📊
examples.body: Cornerstone CPA in Leesburg has done taxes for Northern Virginia families for 19 years — not a franchise, not a chain, a team that picks up the phone. Small business owner? First-time homebuyer? We've seen it all. Book a free 30-minute review before April. No pressure. 🤝

examples.angle: PAIN POINT — specific fear, direct relief
examples.headline: Stop Guessing. Start Planning.
examples.hook: Most Ashburn families don't know if they're on track for retirement. Are you? 🔍
examples.body: Heritage Financial in Ashburn offers a free 45-minute retirement check-in — no products to sell, just an honest look at where you stand. 312 Loudoun families have walked out with an actual plan instead of a spreadsheet and a prayer. Your appointment is on us. 📅
